task: Run the existing direct H3 source-free importer test after extending the checked-body decoder
observation: The targeted H3 runner compiles its verifier with -Werror and fails before executing because type_ir.hpp emits missing-field-initializer warnings from TypeSolver::Undo aggregate entries. The same runner passes when only -Werror is relaxed through a temporary repository-local g++ wrapper.
impact: A pre-existing warning policy blocked the focused regression from running despite the decoder change compiling and passing its own direct test; isolating the warning flag allowed unchanged H3 behavior to be verified without modifying unrelated TypeSolver code.
evidence: python3 tests/tooling/check_phase25_h3_direct_records.py ./moss: initial failure at g++ -Werror on src/type_ir.hpp:1072,1118

resolution.summary: Retained production and existing test sources unchanged; used a temporary wrapper to relax only -Werror for the H3 test invocation.
